title: Spooky Squash Lands
description: Halloween themed biome mod. Adds unique blocks for all biomes
body:
A content mod focused on adding spooky biomes, each with their own themes ranging from frozen glaciers to dense and dark jungles. Each biome contains a pumpkin with the plan to give each pumpkin a unique game mechanic (only the plains pumpkin has one right now which is its size). All biomes except for the glaciers also come with unique wood and leaf variants. This mod is still early in development so the biomes are very barebones.

# Biomes
## Spooky Tundra
A frozen wasteland with glaciers and solid ice covering its surface. Frozen pumpkins are the only sign of plant life in this biome

![Frozen biome filled with glaciers in the middle. A frozen ocean extends to the top right](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77d0aa8ef1db95721a1239c7b44a2b383bb74f1c_0.webp)

## Spooky Plains
A grassland in permanent autumn with large lonely trees. Huge pumpkins cover the grassy landscape

![Grassland with shrubs and a huge pumkin in the background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49d55c91dd86c773dd72b56cb0c377457ee9a405_0.webp)

## Spooky Forest
A dark and swampy biome full of overgrown foliage and cobwebs. Skeletons without weapons emerge from the swamp at night to hunt players. The pumpkins are as hostile as their environment and covered in spikes

![Practically black forest covered in grass and dead shrubs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e85fc4a45847acd0672136bd3b6932371fb8b993_0.webp)

## Spooky Jungle
A tropical rainforest covered in huge trees which cover the entire biome. Despite the trees covering the sky, enough daylight reaches the ground to let plants grow. Pumpkins covered in vines thrive in this overgrown ecosystem

![Vibrant green forest with jungle pumpkins to the right. A desert can be seen on the right of the horizon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/26096021e9cbbae5dc9e208ed9709ad4e66b4652.png)
